Package com.csse3200.game.components.player

Class InventoryComponent

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.Component
com.csse3200.game.components.player.InventoryComponent
public class InventoryComponent extends Component
A component intended to be used by the player to track their inventory.

Stores gold and item slots. Can also be used as a more generic component for other entities.

      Creates an inventory with the default slot capacity of 5.

    • InventoryComponent

      public InventoryComponent(int gold, int maxSlots)
      Creates an inventory with an explicit slot capacity.
      Parameters:
      gold - starting gold; values below 0 are clamped to 0
      maxSlots - maximum number of item slots; must be >= 1
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if maxSlots < 1

    • addItem

      public int addItem(Item item, int quantity)
      Adds a specific quantity using item as a stack template. This supports pickup amounts that exceed a single stack cap.
      Parameters:
      item - item template used for stack compatibility and max quantity
      quantity - quantity to add
      Returns:
      quantity that could not be added; 0 means the complete quantity was added

    • getTotalQuantity

      public int getTotalQuantity(String name, ItemType type, int maxQuantity)
      Returns the total quantity of stacks matching name, type, and maxQuantity across all occupied slots.
      Parameters:
      name - item name to match; null or blank returns 0
      type - item type to match
      maxQuantity - stack cap to match
      Returns:
      summed quantity, or 0 when no matching stacks exist

    • getTotalQuantity

      public int getTotalQuantity(Item template)
      Returns the total quantity of stacks compatible with template.
      Parameters:

      Returns:
      summed quantity, or 0 when template is null

    • splitStack

      public int splitStack(int slot, int splitQty)
      Splits splitQty from an occupied stack into the lowest empty slot.

      Does not compact later slots. Rejects a full-stack transfer; use removeItem(int) instead.

      Parameters:
      slot - occupied slot index in the range 1 to maxSlots
      splitQty - quantity to move into a new stack; must be > 0 and < the source quantity
      Returns:
      the new slot index, or -1 if the split is invalid or no empty slot remains

    • removeItem

      public int removeItem(int slot, int amount)
      Removes up to amount from a single slot. Does not compact later slots.
      Parameters:
      slot - slot index in the range 1 to maxSlots
      amount - quantity to remove
      Returns:
      the amount actually removed; 0 if invalid, empty, or amount <= 0

    • removeItem

      public Item removeItem(int slot)
      Removes the whole stack from a slot. Does not compact later slots.
      Parameters:
      slot - slot index in the range 1 to maxSlots
      Returns:
      the stored item, or null if the slot is invalid or empty

    • canStack

      public boolean canStack(Item existing, Item incoming)
      Returns whether incoming can stack onto existing. Compatibility uses name, type, and max quantity. Item.equals(Object) is identity by unique instance id and must not be used here.
      Parameters:
      existing - item already in a slot; null is not stackable
      incoming - item being added; null is not stackable
      Returns:
      true if the stacks are compatible and existing is not full
